name: Bill Cooper
office: Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency, Member, Board of Directors, Division 1

items.text: Bill Cooper is a vice president of the Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency Board of Directors, representing Division 1. He worked at the Metropolitan Water District of Southern California for about 40 years and managed water treatment plants. He was the agency's first board president when it formed in 2018. His campaign says he will focus on water quality and supplies, repairing infrastructure, preparing for drought, and reviewing spending.
